name: s81ph-dsfd_selt_q2-89fd33a58-safe-tt
purpose: TT-BATCH (owner option B, one large batch): s81ph-dsfd_selt_q2-89fd33a58-safe re-routed at ORFS CORNER=TC (setup repair at TT), flow-hold mm FF hold HM 50, rule H1, CTS fix hooks + consistent die-link budget; original source commit kept; verdict TT setup >= 0 / FF hold >= 0 / DRC 0, SS = sensitivity. | was: SAFE selector quarter (6 x 128x256 macros, registered macro outputs, slice MREG 1), in parallel with s81ph-dsfd_selt_q-cd3337221-b; first to close is adopted
